rationale: The official IM Creator page describes a visual website editor, templates, responsive layouts, hosting and SEO tools. These are conventional website-building capabilities and the record's description aligns. The captured page does not exhaustively document optional features, and version/time applicability is unknown, so negative support is weak rather than treating absent AI wording as dispositive.
version_scope: Unversioned dataset description; contemporary official product page used, no evidence pins record to current release.
issues: Current page documents core website-building features but offers limited historical/version coverage and does not establish absence of all optional AI features.
